papers.title: Canon enables causal inference of downstream genes in single-cell CRISPR studies via instrumental variable analysis.
papers.abstract: A critical analytical task in sc-CRISPR screening is identifying downstream genes influenced by perturbed target genes. Existing methods for this task primarily rely on traditional association-based analyses, which not only fall short in establishing causal relationships between genes but also suffer from high false positive rates and limited statistical power. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a causal inference-based framework that leverages the perturbation status of gRNAs in single cells as instrumental variables (IVs) to infer causal gene relationship via IV analysis. Building upon this framework, we further present Canon, a one-sample IV analysis method specifically tailored to systematically identify genes that are potentially causally influenced by perturbed target genes across diverse sc-CRISPR platforms. Canon ensures robust type I error control while maintaining high statistical power. We evaluated its performance through comprehensive simulations and real data applications. The gene-gene relationships identified by Canon provide valuable insights into the causal gene regulatory network, uncovering candidate therapeutic targets with potential relevance for cancer biology and demonstrating the transformative potential of sc-CRISPR screening to resolve causal regulatory networks at an unprecedented scale.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

summary.takeaway: 提出了Canon，一种基于工具变量分析的单样本因果推断方法，用于在单细胞CRISPR筛选数据中识别被扰动靶基因的下游因果影响基因，以弥补传统关联分析无法建立因果关系的不足。
summary.methods: 利用单细胞中gRNA的扰动状态作为工具变量，构建因果推断框架，开发了Canon方法，并通过模拟和真实数据应用进行了性能评估。
summary.relevance: 该研究聚焦于单细胞扰动数据的因果机制推断，与主题中的单细胞扰动和机制推理直接相关，其工具变量框架可增强基因调控网络推断的因果性。
summary.caveat: 摘要未详细说明Canon对数据质量的具体要求或潜在的混杂因素处理细节，可能限制其适用性。

papers.title: Longitudinal zone- and cell type-specific pattern-triggered immune responses in Arabidopsis roots.
papers.abstract: Roots, composed of diverse cell types across longitudinal developmental zones, are vital for plant survival against microbial challenges. Leveraging single-cell transcriptomics and live-cell imaging of Arabidopsis roots, we reveal here that plant-derived phytocytokines elicit more potent immune responses than microbe-derived patterns across root cell types and zones. The differential expression of receptors and key signaling modules in distinct cell types and zones contributes to the response intensity to specific elicitors. Phytocytokines sustain growth-defense trade-offs by suppressing the expression of receptor-like kinase genes associated with root cell division and elongation. The intensity of immune responses in different root zones is associated with fungal and bacterial pathogen invasion sites. Furthermore, motif-informed network inference highlighted key transcriptional regulators driving cell identity-specific transcriptomic immune responses. Our study provides a comprehensive landscape of transcriptional responses in plant roots in response to diverse immune elicitors, highlighting how distinct phytocytokines orchestrate stage- and cell type-dependent transcriptional reprogramming.

summary.takeaway: 揭示了拟南芥根中不同细胞类型和纵向区域对植物和微生物来源免疫诱导物的差异化响应，以及植物细胞因子通过抑制受体激酶基因表达来维持生长-防御权衡。
summary.methods: 利用单细胞转录组学和活细胞成像分析拟南芥根对多种免疫诱导物的响应，结合基序信息网络推断关键转录调控因子。
summary.relevance: 该研究提供了植物根免疫响应的单细胞图谱，与检索增强和对齐主题相关，可作为植物细胞类型特异性调控网络的数据资源。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提及具体数据规模和统计方法细节，可能限制结果的可重复性评估。

papers.title: Shedding light on neural learning to rank models for anticancer drug prioritization.
papers.abstract: Learning to Rank (LeToR) methods have gained increasing attention in drug response prediction, offering a direct way to prioritize effective treatments for cancer cell lines. In this study, we systematically benchmark six ranking loss functions, including state-of-the-art listwise methods, and five types of molecular representations across two large-scale drug screening datasets, CTRP and PRISM. Using high-dimensional gene expression profiles and various drug fingerprints and descriptors, we evaluated models under multiple validation setups and ranking metrics. Our results demonstrate that listwise loss functions such as LambdaLoss and LambdaRank consistently excel in both early and overall ranking quality. Additionally, combining molecular fingerprints with physicochemical descriptors yielded improved performance. A novel attention-based mechanism and a modified version of RankingSHAP were integrated to enhance interpretability, uncovering key genes and substructures aligned with known biological insights. The explainability pipeline successfully distinguished estrogen receptor-positive (ER⁺) and estrogen receptor-negative (ER-) breast cancer subtypes. The model successfully identified critical substructures in docetaxel, an FDA-approved therapy, and triptolide, which is currently undergoing clinical evaluation for breast cancer. These findings are consistent with established structure-activity relationship (SAR) data. Overall, this study presents a comprehensive evaluation framework and underscores the importance of carefully selecting loss functions and feature representations when developing robust and interpretable drug-ranking systems.

summary.takeaway: 系统比较了六种排序损失函数和五种分子表示在抗癌药物优先级排序中的表现，发现列表式损失函数和组合分子特征能提升排序质量，并通过可解释性分析识别出与已知生物学一致的基因和结构。
summary.methods: 在CTRP和PRISM数据集上，使用基因表达谱和多种药物描述符，结合多种验证设置和排序指标评估模型，并集成注意力机制和修改版RankingSHAP进行可解释性分析。
summary.relevance: 该研究聚焦抗癌药物响应预测和机制解释，与药物扰动机制主题高度相关，其解释性分析有助于理解药物作用分子机制。
summary.caveat: 摘要未明确提供模型性能的统计显著性检验和泛化性验证细节，可能影响结论的稳健性。
